highlightsParams.query: Tailwind CSS v4.0 introduced a not‑* variant supporting the CSS :not() pseudo‑class.

[Tailwind CSS v4.0 > not-* variant] We've added a new `not-*` variant which finally adds support for the CSS `:not()` pseudo-class: … ```
``` … ``` .not-hover\:opacity-75:not(*:hover) { opacity: 75%;}@media not (hover: hover) { .not-hover\:opacity-75 { opacity: 75%; }} ``` It does double duty and also lets you negate media queries and `@supports` queries: ```
